audience: short-term rental hosts and managers who set prices for listings in Wheelhouse

useCases.title: Find listings priced below their recommendation
useCases.text: List the listings, then read the daily recommended prices and the price calendar of one listing.

useCases.title: Find the setups that stop recommended pricing
useCases.text: Read the system flags of a listing, such as a fixed price or a minimum above the recommendation. Read its pricing preferences.

useCases.title: Review occupancy and revenue against last year
useCases.text: Read the rolling KPIs of a listing, such as occupancy, revenue and ADR. Set the basis to the same time last year to compare.

useCases.title: Set a percent price adjustment for a date range
useCases.text: Read the custom rates first. Then set a percent adjustment for each weekday in a date range. This changes live prices.

useCases.title: Add a pricing note to a listing
useCases.text: Read the notes on a listing, then add a note for a stay-date range. A note does not change prices.
